controller.mapping_summary: The explicit two-port profile maps each RetroPad D-pad to an Atari ST joystick and maps A/B as alternate host buttons for the same one-bit fire line; keyboard and mouse remain separate inputs.

files.description: Optional external EmuTOS image overriding the embedded EmuTOS fallback

firmware.notes: The core can fall back to embedded EmuTOS; an external system/SteemSSE/tosEmu.img overrides it. Upstream does not publish a canonical digest for arbitrary replacement images.

saves.naming: The pinned core-info metadata declares libretro_saves=true but does not declare a persistent-save filename extension.
saves.notes: Persistent save support is declared by the pinned core-info metadata; filename and content semantics are not specified there.
